messages.text: Do you ship to Germany, and will the miner come with an EU plug?

Yes, we ship to Germany. As for the plug, it depends on which miner you mean — most of our ASICs (Hammer Miner DC02, DC04, DC08, BC04, NerdQX, Harlo B30) come in an EU plug option, either as a selectable variant or auto-matched to your shipping address. Which model are you looking at, so I can confirm the exact plug and price for you?
